title: Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere Lights Up with BTS ARIRANG Visuals — Runs Nightly Through May 28
detail: The Las Vegas Sphere's iconic Exosphere — the world's largest exterior LED display at 580,000 square feet — begins displaying large-scale BTS ARIRANG-themed visuals on May 22, 2026, running nightly through May 28. The display covers the full spherical exterior in ARIRANG's signature crimson with album-themed artwork and motion graphics, creating a landmark visible across the Las Vegas Strip. This marks the first time BTS content has appeared on the Sphere Exosphere, which did not exist during the 2022 'BTS: The City' Las Vegas campaign. The activation is a centerpiece of 'Global The City 2.0,' described as the largest city-linked K-pop campaign in history, and arrives one day before BTS's first of four Allegiant Stadium ARIRANG World Tour shows (May 23, 24, 27, 28). Also launching May 22 as part of the citywide festival: an official BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Welcome Party at Tailgate Beach Club, and a fan community event at La Mona Rosa in Downtown Las Vegas — giving ARMY pre-concert celebrations the night before shows begin. Seoul Economic Daily reported on the Sphere activation's significance as a new milestone in the HYBE 'Global The City' campaign strategy.

title: Las Vegas Businesses Report ARMY Fan Surge as Allegiant Stadium Shows Approach — Fox5 Feature Coverage
detail: On May 22, 2026 — the day before BTS's first Allegiant Stadium ARIRANG World Tour show — Fox5 Las Vegas publishes a feature documenting the massive ARMY fan surge hitting the city. Local businesses from Chinatown restaurants (including Pho Concept, which stocked 2-4x normal inventory) to Strip hotels report full occupancy and elevated foot traffic. BTS signage appeared at Harry Reid International Airport, and businesses across the Strip and Convention Center district prepared for an estimated 200,000+ fans across the four Allegiant Stadium shows (May 23, 24, 27, 28). The Fox5 report notes that many ARMY members and local Korean-American business owners describe BTS's Las Vegas presence as a significant Asian-American cultural moment. With the Sphere Exosphere ARIRANG visuals lighting the skyline and the citywide red illumination still active, Las Vegas is described as experiencing a 'complete city transformation.' Hotel occupancy data from the Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority showed record bookings for the last week of May 2026, with Korean-American spending projected at $180M across the 12-day festival footprint.

media.caption: Las Vegas businesses prepare for ARMY fan surge as BTS Allegiant Stadium shows begin May 23, 2026
